scope: Compiled original native constructors, affine concatenation/inversion, float matrix/radius stages and CSS-normalized two-stop material. Covers fractional/reversed vectors, non-power-of-two radii, diagonal/reflected/sheared maps and bitmap boundaries. Existing byte-material vectors are unchanged.
compiler: g++ C++20 -O2 -mfma -ffp-contract=off; explicit hardware FMA, avoiding the unfused MinGW fmaf fallback; nearest-even SSE store
